---
title: 'skillpouch settings'
description: 'List or control the preferences synced for each assistant.'
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli.mjs from `skillpouch --help`. Do not edit; run `pnpm --filter @skillpouch/docs gen:cli`. -->

List or control the preferences synced for each assistant.

Entries are named `<file>:<key>`, for example `opencode.json:providers.vultr` or `settings.json:env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`; `skillpouch settings list` shows them. Deleting an entry from an assistant's settings file excludes it on this computer only: the pouch and your other computers keep it. See [Settings sync](/assistants/#settings-sync) for what each assistant syncs.

## Usage

```sh
skillpouch settings <COMMAND>
```

## Commands

| Command                       | What it does                                                 |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `skillpouch settings list`    | List entries and their status, optionally for one assistant. |
| `skillpouch settings exclude` | Stop syncing an entry on this computer (the pouch keeps it). |
| `skillpouch settings include` | Restore an excluded entry from the pouch now.                |

## `skillpouch settings list`

List entries and their status, optionally for one assistant.

### Usage

```sh
skillpouch settings list [ASSISTANT]
```

### Arguments

| Argument      | What it does                                        |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `[ASSISTANT]` | Only this assistant (`claude-code`, `opencode`, …). |

## `skillpouch settings exclude`

Stop syncing an entry on this computer (the pouch keeps it).

### Usage

```sh
skillpouch settings exclude <ASSISTANT> <ENTRY>
```

### Arguments

| Argument      | What it does                                                          |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `<ASSISTANT>` | The assistant (`claude-code`, `opencode`, …).                         |
| `<ENTRY>`     | The entry, as `settings list` shows it (`settings.json:env.API_URL`). |

## `skillpouch settings include`

Restore an excluded entry from the pouch now.

### Usage

```sh
skillpouch settings include <ASSISTANT> <ENTRY>
```

### Arguments

| Argument      | What it does                                                          |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `<ASSISTANT>` | The assistant (`claude-code`, `opencode`, …).                         |
| `<ENTRY>`     | The entry, as `settings list` shows it (`settings.json:env.API_URL`). |
